typedef long long ll;
typedef unsigned long long ull;
typedef long double ld;

const int N = 1e6 + 10;
const int MOD = 998244353;

ll fact[N], inv[N];

ll powmod(ll a, ll b) {
    ll ans = 1;
    for (ll mul = a; b > 0; b >>= 1, mul = mul * mul % MOD) {
        if ((b & 1) != 0) ans = ans * mul % MOD;
    }
    return ans;
}

ll comb(int i, int j) {

}

void solve() {

    fact[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) fact[i + 1] = fact[i] * (i + 1) % MOD;
    inv[n] = powmod(fact[n], MOD - 2);
    for (int i = n; i > 0; --i) inv[i - 1] = inv[i] * i % MOD;

        cout << fact[n] << endl;

        ans = ans * 2 * comb(n, k2) % MOD;
        cout << ans << endl;
    }
}

    while (t--) {
